# Psalm 70 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 70:1 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** For-the-choirmaster. Of-David. To-bring-to-remembrance.
- **LOGOS:** For the choirmaster. Of David, for the memorial offering.
- **PNEUMA:** For the music director. A psalm of David, asking God to remember him.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 70:2 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** O-God, to-deliver-me — YHWH, to-my-help — hasten!
- **LOGOS:** Make haste, O God, to deliver me! O LORD, make haste to help me!
- **PNEUMA:** Please, God, rescue me! Come quickly, LORD, and help me.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 70:3 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Let-them-be-put-to-shame and-humiliated, those-seeking my-soul; let-them-be-turned-back and-disgraced, those-delighting in-my-harm.
- **LOGOS:** Let them be put to shame and confusion who seek my life! Let them be turned back and brought to dishonor who delight in my hurt!
- **PNEUMA:** May those who try to kill me be humiliated and put to shame. May those who take delight in my trouble be turned back in disgrace.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 70:4 (overlap: 7%)

- **EMET:** Let-them-turn-back because-of their-shame, those-saying, 'Aha! Aha!'
- **LOGOS:** Let them turn back because of their shame who say, 'Aha, Aha!'
- **PNEUMA:** Let them be horrified by their shame, for they said, 'Aha! We've got him now!'

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 70:5 (overlap: 13%)

- **EMET:** Let-all those-seeking-You rejoice and-be-glad in-You; and-let-those-loving Your-salvation say continually, 'Great [is] God!'
- **LOGOS:** May all who seek You rejoice and be glad in You! May those who love Your salvation say evermore, 'God is great!'
- **PNEUMA:** But may all who search for You be filled with joy and gladness in You. May those who love Your salvation repeatedly shout, 'God is great!'

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
